scope_note: This protocol evaluates TECHNICAL ENGINE V2 only (technical_score / signal_class / component-family outputs). It is NOT a full DecisionEngine validation and NOT a news/macro validation. BacktestEngine does not reconstruct historical news/macro channel scores, so no result under this protocol may be described as full AL/SAT system out-of-sample performance.

methodology_references.methodology_source_fingerprint_algorithm: methodology_fingerprint.compute_methodology_source_fingerprint(normalize_newlines=True): SHA-256 of canonical JSON {path: SHA-256(file bytes with CRLF->LF)} over the 27 METHODOLOGY_FINGERPRINT_FILES. Equals the fingerprint of the git blobs at methodology_git_commit.

primary_research_question: Do Technical V2 bullish signal classes identify symbol-sessions with a higher probability of positive 10-session forward return than non-bullish Technical V2 observations?

class_groups.grouping_note: non_bullish is a mechanical comparison group only, not a semantic claim that its members are behaviorally neutral. Observations with technical_score=None or any methodology/data hard-veto are not valid comparison observations -- they are excluded and counted separately, never assigned to either group.

observation_unit_note: One valid Technical V2 analysis for one symbol after one completed BIST daily session. Persistent signals generate multiple symbol-session rows; dependence is handled statistically (block bootstrap), rows are not claimed independent.

horizons.override_rule: Secondary horizons (5, 20) may never override, replace, or be substituted for the formal 10-session primary conclusion, and may not be used to retroactively select a horizon after viewing results.

execution_and_return_definition.signal_timing: Signal generated from the completed close of session T.
execution_and_return_definition.e1_definition: E1 = first eligible BIST session after T.

primary_metric.name: date_balanced_delta_hit_rate_10
primary_metric.definition: For each signal date d: bullish_hit_rate_d = fraction of valid, matured bullish observations on date d with R10 > 0; non_bullish_hit_rate_d = fraction of valid, matured non-bullish observations on date d with R10 > 0; daily_delta_d = bullish_hit_rate_d - non_bullish_hit_rate_d. A date contributes to the primary estimator only if it has at least one valid matured bullish observation AND at least one valid matured non-bullish observation. Dates lacking either group are counted under primary_non_comparable_date_count with a group-absence reason, never silently dropped. Primary estimator delta_hit_rate_10 = arithmetic mean of daily_delta_d across primary-comparable dates only (each comparable date weighted equally, not weighted by symbol count).

null_hypothesis_note: The null is NOT bullish_hit_rate = 50%. Market-wide positive drift can make unconditional equity hit rates exceed 50% without any classifier skill, so the comparison is against the holdout's own contemporaneous non-bullish base rate, not a fixed constant.

algorithm_contract: Build the ordered BIST session-date grid over the full formal evaluation interval.
daily_delta_d may be defined or unavailable (non-comparable) on each session date in this grid.
Candidate blocks are contiguous 20-session blocks drawn from the FULL ordered grid, not from a pre-filtered comparable-dates-only grid.
Concatenate sampled blocks until at least the original number of session dates is reached, then trim to the original grid length.
Recompute the mean daily_delta_d using only the defined/comparable dates occurring in the sampled grid.
All symbols belonging to a sampled date are preserved together (date-level resampling, not row-level).
If a bootstrap replicate has no defined daily_delta at all, mark that replicate invalid and exclude it from the percentile calculation; report the invalid-replicate count.
If the CI cannot be computed reproducibly (e.g. too few comparable dates), the formal result is NOT_EVALUABLE and data collection continues -- no result is invented.

formal_primary_conclusion_labels.EVIDENCE_OPPOSITE_DIRECTION: CI_high < 0 (optional label, only used if it actually occurs)
formal_primary_conclusion_labels.NOT_EVALUABLE: CI cannot be computed reproducibly at the first formal checkpoint

reported_always: individual results for all seven frozen signal_class values (STRONG_BULLISH_INITIATION, BULLISH_CONFIRMED, BULLISH_CANDIDATE, BEARISH_CANDIDATE, NO_SIGNAL, WATCHLIST, NEUTRAL)
rules: Require no formal multiplicity correction because they are never used to claim formal significance on their own.
Cannot replace or override the 10-session primary result.
Cannot be used to select or retune the primary horizon after data collection begins.
No bearish STRONG tier may be invented for symmetry; BEARISH_CANDIDATE is reported as its own frozen secondary class.

bullish_episode_definition.start_rule: An episode begins for a symbol when the current valid signal_class is in the bullish set AND the previous eligible session for that symbol was not in the bullish set.
bullish_episode_definition.continuation_rule: Transitions among BULLISH_CANDIDATE, BULLISH_CONFIRMED, and STRONG_BULLISH_INITIATION remain the SAME episode.
bullish_episode_definition.end_rule: The episode ends the first eligible session the symbol's class leaves the bullish set.
bullish_episode_definition.missing_session_rule: If an eligible session is unavailable/excluded due to any data-quality or methodology hard-veto, episode continuity is BROKEN (not assumed to continue across the gap). The next valid bullish observation after such a gap begins a NEW episode.

sample_and_calendar_floors.episode_floor_interpretation: A conservative predeclared diversity/sample floor intended to avoid interpreting a tiny number of persistent bullish episodes. It is NOT described as, and does not guarantee, any specific statistical precision (e.g. it is not a +/-10 percentage point precision guarantee) for the date-balanced primary estimator.
sample_and_calendar_floors.matured_definition: An episode is matured once its required primary E10 outcome is available.
sample_and_calendar_floors.first_formal_evaluation_rule: The later of: (A) at least 100 matured bullish episodes, (B) at least 6 calendar months elapsed since effective_holdout_start, AND (C) all observations entering the primary evaluation set have fully matured through E10. If the episode floor takes longer than 6 months, evaluation waits for the floor; there is no maximum stopping date.

performance_visibility_note: Before the first formal evaluation checkpoint, no accuracy/hit-rate/return/class-performance/benchmark-relative/strategy-return figures of any kind may be exposed to anyone with authority to change methodology or protocol. Exposing such figures before the checkpoint constitutes a HIGH contamination risk (it would silently convert accumulating V2 holdout data into de facto tuning data without an honest protocol-version relabeling). Permitted operational monitoring during accumulation is limited to: pipeline health, number of captured records, missing/exclusion counts, config identity confirmation (commit/hash unchanged), manifest identity, and snapshot-integrity checks.

transaction_costs_and_simulated_strategy.primary_claim_type: classifier discrimination, not a trading P&L claim
transaction_costs_and_simulated_strategy.simulated_strategy_reporting: gross only; no net-P&L claim is made until a separately sourced and frozen transaction-cost/slippage assumption exists. No fee percentage is invented by this protocol.

benchmark.caveat: Benchmark data-quality processing (get_benchmark_close_series) is not currently fully parity-locked with individual-asset processing -- it does not run filter_completed_daily_bars / normalize_bist_daily_sessions / check_trading_day_continuity / check_raw_ohlcv_integrity the way individual asset data does. The primary statistic does not depend on XU100 for this reason.

excluded_from_evaluation_definition.confidence_role: secondary/descriptive only (e.g. does higher agreement associate with more consistent outcomes), never primary, unless a separate calibration protocol is later frozen

excluded_categories: forward horizon lacking sufficient completed future sessions

holdout_status.activation_note: Protocol freeze/commit alone does NOT start the holdout. The effective_holdout_start, once activation completes, will be the first BIST session whose market open occurs strictly after the FINAL activation-lock event (the later of protocol freeze and evidence-capture readiness -- methodology freeze already occurred earlier). No session before that final activation event is eligible.

evidence_record_note: Not implemented in this protocol turn. The snapshot mechanism must preserve the exact historical-bar versions actually consumed at each evaluation time -- a 'first-seen-only' bar store is explicitly insufficient, since a provider may revise a bar before a later evaluation consumes the revised value.

universe.membership_source_evidence_note: The primary KAP endpoint was fetched directly this turn (WebFetch), saved locally as a 196-page PDF (application/pdf, ~346KB), independently text-extracted with pypdf (installed this turn for this task), and independently regex-parsed for the 'BIST 100' numbered constituent table (rows 1-100, ignoring one spurious mid-table 'BIST 50' running-header artifact at the page boundary between row 83 and row 84). The independently parsed 100-symbol, ordered list was compared programmatically against the user-supplied transcript: exact set equality (100/100, 100 unique) AND exact order equality, with zero symbols differing in either direction.
universe.membership_source_crosscheck: Borsa Istanbul BIST Stock Indices Periodic Review
universe.no_post_hoc_exclusion_rule: No symbol may be removed from this frozen universe after holdout activation because of observed performance. Only the predeclared data-quality/methodology hard-vetoes already governing TechnicalAnalysisEngine remain valid exclusion reasons, applied per symbol-session, not per symbol.
universe.v2_note: Identical frozen 100-symbol universe and membership evidence as TECHNICAL_V1_PROTOCOL_V1 (the classifier change does not change the universe). Membership period 2026-07-01..2026-09-30 is recorded as-is; the universe stays fixed at protocol freeze regardless of later index reviews (no post-hoc replacement).

protocol_versioning_rule.v2_rule: If any listed field changes after holdout activation, the changed protocol becomes TECHNICAL_V2_PROTOCOL_V2. A new protocol version may not claim this version's already-observed data as untouched holdout for its own validation.

supersedes.status: SUPERSEDED before any holdout activation (effective_holdout_start null). New V1 attempts/activation are rejected under engine 1.15.0; V1 artifacts remain readable historical records.

change_provenance.not_validation: TECH-VOL 1A retrospective observations justified the change and are NOT Technical V2 performance evidence. V2 prospective evidence begins only after a future authorized activation.
change_provenance.statistics_unchanged: Primary question, metric, horizons, return definition, bootstrap, floors, visibility, costs, benchmark, missing-data policy and schedule are carried over unchanged from TECHNICAL_V1_PROTOCOL_V1.
